options.name: label
options.description: Chart title: visible text and the accessible name of the plot (aria-labelledby); also the data table caption.

options.name: hideLabel
options.description: Visually hide the title; it stays the accessible name.

options.name: description
options.description: Visible description below the title, also referenced by aria-describedby (text only).

options.name: summary
options.description: Replaces the generated accessible summary (shown path, item count, total, three largest items).

options.name: valueFormat
options.description: Number format for values in tile labels, tooltips, the data table, and the summary (percentages use a percent format).

options.name: formatValue
options.description: Custom value text; overrides valueFormat everywhere.

options.name: hiddenSeries
options.description: Shared chart option; a treemap has no series, so it has no effect.

options.name: data
options.description: Top-level nodes: { id (unique across the tree), label, value?: number | null, children?: TreemapNode[], color?: 1-8 }. Groups default to the sum of their children (a positive own value takes precedence). Zero, negative, and missing values are not plotted. At most 32 levels of nesting.

options.name: root
options.description: Id of the group to show (drill-down state); null shows the top level. An unknown id or a leaf falls back to the top level. Setting it through update() emits no event.

options.name: drillDown
options.description: Allow opening groups by click and Enter/Space and going up with Backspace and the breadcrumb. false: groups are plain tiles and no breadcrumb is shown (drillTo() still works).

options.name: rootLabel
options.description: Name of the top level in the breadcrumb and the "Showing ..." text (default: localized "All").

options.name: theme
options.description: Look and feel: { palette?: string[] (1-8 CSS colors for slots 1-8); fontFamily?; fontSize? (8-32 px); textColor?; gridLines?: boolean; gridColor?; gridDash? ("4 2" or "none"); axisColor?; lineWidth? (0.5-12 px); markerSize? (1-20 px); cornerRadius?, barRadius?, cellRadius?, sliceRadius?, boxRadius? (0-50 px); swatchRadius? (0-8 px); tooltipRadius?, controlRadius? (0-50 px); lineJoin?: 'round' | 'miter' | 'bevel'; areaOpacity? (0-1); gradient?: boolean; valueLabelColor?; tooltip?: { background?, color?, borderColor? }; legendPosition?: 'top' | 'bottom' | 'start' | 'end'; animation?: boolean | { duration?: number (0-5000 ms) } }. Applied as --aui-chart-* custom properties and classes on the host through the CSSOM (CSP-safe); colors are validated with CSS.supports('color'). Animation is opt-in and never runs with prefers-reduced-motion: reduce or [data-aui-animation='none'].

options.name: renderTooltip
options.description: Custom tooltip content as DOM nodes (never HTML strings). context: { title, rows: { label, value, seriesId }[], column, row, source: "pointer" | "focus" | "sync" }. Return null for the default tooltip. The tooltip stays aria-hidden; the focused mark keeps its accessible label.

options.name: syncGroup
options.description: Synchronized crosshair: charts with the same group show the crosshair, highlight, and tooltip at the same column (category or x index) when one of them is hovered or focused. Focus never moves between charts. Use charts that share their categories or x values.

options.name: legend
options.description: Shared chart option; a treemap labels its tiles directly and never shows a legend, so it has no effect.

options.name: dataTable
options.description: Data table of the whole hierarchy (name path, value, share of parent): behind a Show data table button (built on first open), always visible, visually hidden (screen readers only), or none.

options.name: tooltip
options.description: Tooltip on pointer hover and keyboard focus (label, value, share).

options.name: patterns
options.description: Texture fills on tiles (by position in the shown level) so neighbors never differ by color alone (always on in forced colors).

options.name: height
options.description: Plot height in CSS px (integer 120-2000); the width follows the container.

options.name: tileLabels
options.description: Print the label (groups that open end with ">") and the value inside tiles that are large enough.

options.name: locale
options.description: Number and message locale.

options.name: direction
options.description: rtl mirrors the layout (largest tile at the top right), right-aligns tile labels, and swaps ArrowLeft/ArrowRight.

properties.name: element
properties.description: The plot (svg role="group"), named by the title and described by the summary.

properties.name: root
properties.description: Id of the shown group (null: top level).

properties.name: path
properties.description: Ids from the top level to the shown group (empty at the top level).

properties.name: hiddenSeries
properties.description: Shared chart property; always empty for a treemap.

methods.name: drillTo
methods.description: Show the group id (null: top level). Ignored for leaves, unknown ids, and the current group. Emits aui-drill and announces "Showing {path}" politely; when focus was in the chart it moves to the largest tile (going down) or the group you came from (going up).

methods.name: update
methods.description: Merge, validate, and re-render. Invalid options throw and keep the previous state. A root in the options replaces the shown group (no event).

methods.name: setSeriesVisible
methods.description: Shared chart method; a treemap has no series, so it only re-renders.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Remove rendering, host classes, listeners, the resize observer, and the configuration subscription.

events.name: aui-drill
events.description: The shown group changed through a tile (click, Enter/Space), Backspace, the breadcrumb, or drillTo(). id: the shown group (null: top level); path: ids from the top level. Not emitted for update({ root }).

events.name: aui-point-click
events.detail: TreemapPointClickDetail = ChartPointClickDetail: { seriesId: string | null; column: number; row: number; label: string; series: string; value: string; source: 'pointer' | 'keyboard' }
events.description: A data mark was activated: pointer click or tap, or Enter / Space on the focused mark. label is the category, x value, or item; value is the formatted value text. Keyboard navigation is unchanged.

cssClasses.name: aui-chart
cssClasses.description: Host (shared chart chrome).

cssClasses.name: aui-treemap
cssClasses.description: Host modifier for this chart type.

cssClasses.name: aui-chart--patterns
cssClasses.description: patterns option on: tile textures shown.

cssClasses.name: aui-chart__header / __title / __title--hidden / __description / __toolbar
cssClasses.description: Title, description, and the toolbar that holds the breadcrumb.

cssClasses.name: aui-treemap__path / __path-list / __path-item / __path-button
cssClasses.description: Breadcrumb (nav "Treemap path"): ancestor buttons and the current level (aria-current="location").

cssClasses.name: aui-chart__body / __svg / __layer
cssClasses.description: Plot container (height from --aui-chart-height), SVG, and drawing layer.

cssClasses.name: aui-chart__series--c1 ... --c8
cssClasses.description: Palette slot classes; set --aui-chart-color from color-chart-<n>.

cssClasses.name: aui-chart__pattern / aui-chart__pattern-tile
cssClasses.description: Texture overlays.

cssClasses.name: aui-treemap__tiles / __tile-group / __tile / __tile--group
cssClasses.description: Tile layer, per-tile group, focusable tile (also aui-chart__mark), and tiles that open (pointer cursor).

cssClasses.name: aui-treemap__labels / __label / __value
cssClasses.description: aria-hidden printed labels and values (also aui-chart__value-label).

cssClasses.name: aui-chart__mark / __mark--active / __mark--hover
cssClasses.description: Focusable tile and its states (thicker color-text outline).

cssClasses.name: aui-chart__tooltip / __tooltip-title / __tooltip-rows / __tooltip-row / __tooltip-label / __tooltip-value
cssClasses.description: Tooltip (aria-hidden; the focused tile carries the same text).

cssClasses.name: aui-chart__empty
cssClasses.description: Empty state text (No data).

cssClasses.name: aui-chart__summary
cssClasses.description: Hidden summary referenced by aria-describedby.

cssClasses.name: aui-chart__data / __data--hidden / __table-toggle / __table-scroll / __table / __cell--numeric
cssClasses.description: Data table fallback.

cssClasses.name: aui-chart--legend-bottom / --legend-start / --legend-end
cssClasses.description: theme.legendPosition (top is the default layout).

cssClasses.name: aui-chart--no-grid / --gradient / --animate / --entering
cssClasses.description: theme.gridLines: false, theme.gradient, theme.animation (entering: the render that animates).

cssClasses.name: aui-chart__annotations / __annotation-line / __annotation-band / __annotation-label / __annotation--<tone>
cssClasses.description: Annotations (aria-hidden), drawn under the marks.

cssClasses.name: aui-chart__gradient / __gradient-stop
cssClasses.description: Gradient fills (theme.gradient).

cssClasses.name: aui-chart__tooltip--custom
cssClasses.description: Tooltip content comes from renderTooltip.
